integrity: The stated formulas are supported by an analytic coupon-collector, stochastic-order, Gumbel, and Fourier proof. Independent rational-arithmetic checks are finite corroboration, not certificates for asymptotic claims.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple complete bipartite graphs only; nonlazy uniform walks starting in one specified part. The logistic window requires asymptotically equal part sizes, and the sharp total-variation constant is asymptotic. Some historical full text could not be inspected.
title: Last-discovery bias and a logistic balance window on complete bipartite graphs
